profile.headline: IT Software Engineer II
profile.summary:
I’m a full-stack software engineer who enjoys turning complex problems into practical, user-friendly solutions. I’ve worked on everything from clinician-facing safety platforms to AI-powered chatbot improvements, with a strong focus on usability, accessibility, and real-world impact.
My background includes .NET, C#, TypeScript, React, AWS, and Azure AI, and I’m comfortable owning features end-to-end—from designing backend services to building clean, intuitive frontends. I’ve also led efforts to improve accessibility and streamline internal workflows, helping teams work more efficiently.
I’m especially interested in roles where I can continue growing as an engineer, contribute to meaningful products, and work on systems that balance technical depth with great user experience.

positions.title: Information Technology Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed an interactive video game to enhance cyber security awareness across the company. The game simulated real-world threats, such as phishing attacks, enabling employees to learn critical security practices in an engaging way.
• Utilized Microsoft Power Apps and Power Automate to provide various teams with time saving solutions for daily tasks.
• Spearheaded enhancements to the AI chatbot using Prompt Flow in Azure AI Studio, driving significant improvements in user engagement metrics.
• Mentored new interns and members of the Technology Leadership Development program.
positions.insights: SharePoint, Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and +6 skills

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Supported student comprehension of Python and Java, providing guidance both in and out of class.

positions.title: Student Intern
positions.description: I had the privilege to work as a student worker at Virginia Premier in the Summer of 2019. I would make calls to health care providers, locate errors in documentation of member information, and I had an opportunity to strengthen my skills in HTML by making adjustments to my department's employee portal. Through this internship, I was also introduced to SQL.
